services.name: Private 2 Hour Sunset Cruise
services.desc: 2 Hours Join us for our two hour sunset tour of Galveston’s Harbor! Guests are welcome to bring snacks, beer, or wine (no glass drinking containers) aboard to make the trip more enjoyable. Perfect for couples that want to sip champagne and watch the sunset or a group of friends just looking for something different to do, the trip will not Ages 10+ Recommended • The best way to see the sunset in Galveston.

blurb: Guests take a 25-minute jet boat thrill ride on a boat holding up to 11 passengers. The ride involves some spray and requires guests to remove shoes before boarding. Restrictions include minimum age 4, no pregnant women, and no guests under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
extraNote: Jet boat is not handicapped accessible but exceptions possible case by case · No BYOB allowed on jet boat tours · Please don't forget to tip our crew! · Customers will receive a full refund with notice of cancellation 24 hours before trip departure. · Cancellations day of trip will be charged full price and not be eligible for refund. · You can request a full refund or gift card if you cancel within the allotted timeframe by heading to your confirmation email. · NO CALL, NO TEXT, NO-SHOW, NO REFUNDS. · Private Charters are non-refundable. · Pier 19 in Downtown Galveston, at 1902 Wharf Rd.
